id: title:Gilbert09:resume mongodb sync after a getmore hits the execution time limit

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion recovery and reliability: P1.F1.H1 distinguishes MongoDB MaxTimeMSExpired errors to prevent misclassification as generic timeouts; P1.F1.H2 implements recovery and re-raise logic to resume ingestion after execution timeouts while preserving data integrity; P1.F2.H1 adds regression tests to verify recovery behavior.
review.reason: Adds execution timeout recovery and no-progress behavior handling, including distinguishing MongoDB MaxTimeMSExpired errors and resuming ingestion after timeouts while preserving data integrity.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied hunk observations; unverified outcomes such as actual production recovery and incident avoidance are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error code constant and its handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Distinguishes MongoDB OperationFailure code 50 (MaxTimeMSExpired) from other errors in warehouse ingestion, allowing recovery or re-raise instead of treating it as a generic no_cursor_timeout.

observations.behavior: Adds recovery and re-raise logic for execution timeouts.
observations.code_quote: f"MongoDB: operation exceeded time limit for collection={collection_name}; "
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if an execution timeout occurred while no rows were yielded; if no rows, it re-raises immediately. Otherwise, it closes the cursor, re-opens it, and resumes from the last known document ID, preventing infinite retry loops while preserving data integrity.

observations.behavior: Adds regression tests for execution timeout recovery and no-progress behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests that the ingestion pipeline correctly resumes from the last yielded document after an execution timeout and does not retry indefinitely when no progress is made.
